items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: he and Tony Morello. They were friends I had there. We would play any hour.

ctx.x: Yeah I was starting. I mean I’ve never been what I call a tunesmith, but I was trying to learn tunes and build up repertoire. And like playing that jazz gig after hours. And if I didn’t have a jazz gig I would be out at a guy’s house, some guys, Joe Morello, he’s also

an Upstate, from Niagara Falls, he and Tony Morello. They were friends I had there. We would play any hour. Sometimes it was just him and I, tenor sax and bass we would play. Well here’s how this tune goes. Because it’s such a learning — I mean still at this point I’m still learning stuff. It’s a lifelong learning venture, as you know being a musician yourself. So I was trying to build some repertoire and learn some things.
